accountingBoundary.principle: Only capital crossing the company boundary can change Invested/Distributions. Internal DeFi operations do not.
accountingBoundary.contribution: External capital entering the Monetra wallet/company boundary.
accountingBoundary.distribution: Capital leaving the Monetra company boundary.
accountingBoundary.stablePrincipalValuation: Base stablecoin boundary flows are valued in nominal stable units. Yield-bearing wrapper boundary flows require historical canonical NAV.
accountingBoundary.nativeGas: Native ETH / chain gas funding is excluded from Stable Capital Invested. It is retained only as company-origin evidence.
accountingBoundary.performance: Performance = Current Stable Capital + Current Claimable + external distributions - gross external contributions. Current APY is never used to backfill historical performance.

nativeFunding.treatment: company-origin-only; excluded from Stable Capital Invested
